typography.font_family: Tajawal, Cairo, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, sans-serif
typography.rtl_rules: Left-align paragraphs for readability (rtl:text-right). Icons on the right of text in RTL.

layout_and_spacing.internal_spacing: p-4 to p-6 for main sections. gap-4 between chat messages. gap-2 between action chips.

fab.style: h-14 w-14 rounded-full bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-700 text-white shadow-lg shadow-violet-600/30 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95

header.container: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-border/40 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-t-[24px] mobile:rounded-t-[32px]
header.avatar: h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-900/30 flex items-center justify-center text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 relative
header.status_indicator: absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 h-3 w-3 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full border-2 border-white dark:border-zinc-950
header.icon_button: h-8 w-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 transition-colors

tabs.container: flex p-1 bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 rounded-xl mx-4 mt-4 backdrop-blur-md
tabs.tab: flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all
tabs.badge: h-5 min-w-[20px] rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center px-1 font-bold

assistant_bubble.bubble: bg-violet-50/50 dark:bg-violet-900/10 border border-violet-100/50 dark:border-violet-800/30 p-3 rounded-2xl rtl:rounded-br-sm ltr:rounded-bl-sm text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 leading-relaxed shadow-sm
assistant_bubble.avatar: h-6 w-6 rounded-md bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-900/50 flex-shrink-0

user_bubble.wrapper: flex justify-end max-w-[85%] mr-auto rtl:mr-0 rtl:ml-auto items-end gap-2
user_bubble.bubble: bg-violet-600 text-white p-3 rounded-2xl rtl:rounded-bl-sm ltr:rounded-br-sm text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-md shadow-violet-600/10

erp_cards.container: mt-3 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
erp_cards.top_bar: h-1 bg-gradient-to-r rtl:bg-gradient-to-l from-violet-500 to-violet-300 dark:from-violet-600 dark:to-violet-400
erp_cards.header: px-4 pt-4 pb-2 flex items-center justify-between
erp_cards.field_row: flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/50 pb-2 last:border-0 last:pb-0
erp_cards.chip: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-900/20 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300 hover:bg-violet-100 dark:hover:bg-violet-900/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-violet-100 dark:border-violet-800/50

input_bar.container: p-4 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800
input_bar.input_wrapper: relative flex items-center bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-1 shadow-inner
input_bar.input_field: w-full bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 text-sm px-4 py-3 placeholder:text-zinc-400 resize-none h-[44px] max-h-[120px]
input_bar.mic_button: p-2 rounded-xl text-zinc-400 hover:text-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-50 dark:hover:bg-violet-900/20 transition-colors
input_bar.send_button: p-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 text-white hover:bg-violet-700 transition-colors shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed

control_center_tab.kpi_card: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col gap-2
control_center_tab.approval_card: col-span-2 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-amber-900/10 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/30 rounded-2xl p-4
control_center_tab.approve_btn: flex-1 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition-colors
control_center_tab.reject_btn: flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors

typing_indicator.container: flex items-center gap-1.5 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-violet-50/30 dark:bg-violet-900/10 border border-violet-100/30 dark:border-violet-800/20 w-fit
typing_indicator.text: text-xs text-violet-500/70 ml-2 rtl:ml-0 rtl:mr-2 font-medium

suggestion_chips.chip: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:border-violet-300 dark:hover:border-violet-700 hover:text-violet-600 dark:hover:text-violet-400 hover:bg-violet-50 dark:hover:bg-violet-900/20 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm

settings_panel.container: absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-950/95 backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col
settings_panel.model_card_active: p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-violet-500 bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-900/20
settings_panel.model_card_inactive: p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:border-violet-300 transition-colors

animations.drawer_entrance: framer-motion: initial={{ y: 20, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
animations.mobile_sheet: framer-motion: initial={{ y: '100%' }} animate={{ y: 0 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}
animations.message_stagger: framer-motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
animations.tab_indicator: framer-motion: layoutId='activeTab' absolute inset-0 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg shadow-sm

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `dir="rtl"` is properly supported using logical tailwind classes (e.g., `rtl:ml-auto`, `ltr:mr-auto`, `rtl:rounded-br-sm`) where explicit direction is needed, or rely on flex-row-reverse if setting direction globally.
Do NOT use raw Shadcn card/tabs if they clash with these highly customized Hostinger-Kodee-style rounded designs; modify them deeply with Tailwind or use standard semantic HTML with framer-motion.
Implement the mobile view as a true Bottom Sheet (`fixed bottom-0` taking 85vh) with a drag handle (`w-12 h-1.5 bg-zinc-300 rounded-full mx-auto my-3`) when window width < 768px.
Maintain the distinct visual separation between the chat tab and the control center tab. The Control Center should feel like a dense, data-rich Bento grid.
Keep all existing functionalities: model switching, ERP cards rendering, and voice dictation.
Ensure all interactive elements have proper `data-testid` attributes.
